constraints: The platform must support real-time code evaluation.
The system should handle multiple concurrent users efficiently.
requirements.target_users: Students, competitive programmers, and individuals preparing for coding interviews.
requirements.data_requirements: The platform must store user profiles, problem data, submission history, and leaderboard information.

tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for browsing and searching problems in the library.

tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage problem data, including fetching, filtering, and searching.

tasks.name: Set Up Problem Database
tasks.description: Design and implement the database schema to store problem details, tags, and difficulty levels.

tasks.name: Develop Code Submission UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for users to submit their code for evaluation.

tasks.name: Implement Code Evaluation System
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to compile, run, and evaluate user-submitted code against test cases.

tasks.name: Design User Profile UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface for user profiles, displaying user stats and achievements.

tasks.name: Implement User Profile Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage user data, including stats, achievements, and preferences.

tasks.name: Create Leaderboard UI
tasks.description: Design the frontend interface for the leaderboard, showing top users and their rankings.

tasks.name: Implement Leaderboard Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and update user rankings based on their performance.

tasks.name: Add Hints and Solutions UI
tasks.description: Create the frontend interface to display hints and solutions for problems.

tasks.name: Implement Hints and Solutions Backend
tasks.description: Develop the backend to manage and serve hints and solutions for problems.

tasks.name: Test Problem Library Functionality
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the problem library works as expected, including search and filtering.

tasks.name: Test Code Submission and Evaluation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the code submission and evaluation system works correctly.

tasks.name: Test User Profiles
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure user profiles display correct data and update properly.

tasks.name: Test Leaderboard
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure the leaderboard displays accurate rankings and updates correctly.

tasks.name: Test Hints and Solutions
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure hints and solutions are displayed and managed correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy ACM Problem-Solving Platform
tasks.description: Deploy the platform to a production environment, ensuring all components are functional.

T1.implementation_approach: Use a component-based design approach with a framework like React or Angular. Create reusable components for problem cards, filters, and search functionality.
T1.notes: Focus on user-friendly navigation and responsive design.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion. Use a framework like Express.js or Django.
T2.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling for API endpoints.

T3.implementation_approach: Design a relational database schema with tables for problems, categories, and tags. Use an ORM like Sequelize or SQLAlchemy.
T3.notes: Optimize schema for query performance and scalability.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a form-based interface for code submission with syntax highlighting and file upload support.
T4.notes: Include real-time feedback for syntax errors and submission status.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement a sandboxed environment to execute user-submitted code securely. Compare outputs with expected results.
T5.notes: Ensure security and prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a profile page displaying user details, activity history, and achievements.
T6.notes: Incorporate visual elements like charts for user statistics.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop APIs for user profile management, including updating details and fetching activity data.
T7.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data and authentication.

T8.implementation_approach: Create a leaderboard interface with sorting and filtering options for rankings.
T8.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and responsive design.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to fetch leaderboard data and update rankings based on user performance.
T9.notes: Implement caching for frequently accessed data.

T10.implementation_approach: Design an interface to display hints and solutions for problems, with collapsible sections for better readability.
T10.notes: Ensure hints and solutions are accessible only after certain conditions are met.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage hints and solutions, including creation, retrieval, and access control.
T11.notes: Implement role-based access control for managing hints and solutions.

T12.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for the problem library functionality using a testing framework.
T12.notes: Focus on edge cases and API response validation.

T13.implementation_approach: Test the code submission and evaluation system for correctness, security, and performance.
T13.notes: Simulate various scenarios, including malicious code submissions.

T14.implementation_approach: Test user profile functionalities, including data retrieval, updates, and activity tracking.
T14.notes: Ensure data consistency and proper authentication.

T15.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionalities, including sorting, filtering, and real-time updates.

T16.implementation_approach: Test hints and solutions functionalities, including access control and content display.
T16.notes: Ensure proper access restrictions and content formatting.

T17.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform using a cloud service provider. Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
T17.notes: Ensure scalability, security, and monitoring for the deployed platform.

from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=db.func.current_timestamp(), onupdate=db.func.current_timestamp())

from app.database import db

class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(128), nullable=False)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f'<User {self.username}>'

from app.database import db


class Solution(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'solutions'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False)
    problem_id = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False)
    code = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    language = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    submission_time = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, default=db.func.current_timestamp())
    status = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)

    def __init__(self, user_id, problem_id, code, language, status):
        self.user_id = user_id
        self.problem_id = problem_id
        self.code = code
        self.language = language
        self.status = status

# app/routes.py

from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_blueprint
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_blueprint
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_blueprint

def register_blueprints(app):
    """
    Registers all blueprints for the application.
    :param app: Flask application instance
    """
    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint, url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint, url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint, url_prefix='/solutions')

from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.routes import problem_blueprint, user_blueprint, solution_blueprint

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    
    # Configuration can be added here
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint, url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint, url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint, url_prefix='/solutions')

    return app

from app import create_app

# Entry point for the ACM Problem-Solving Platform application
if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = create_app()
    app.run(debug=True)

# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

## Features

- Problem Library: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Solutions: Provides optional hints and detailed solutions for problems to aid learning.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
